asr.full_text: Hey guys, it's Neyman yeah ! And today I want to show one really cool way how you can create amazing eye catching Instagram stories, post, Facebook post, Pinterest, YouTube covers, or basically any kind of design that you need fast and easy. Using Adobe spark at their two versions of the app one is for web another is for mobile phone and they're practically the same with the difference that the web version has a branding option so you can set your brand logo color palette and font. And later use it both on the phone and on the web with just one click you can have a consistency in all of your design of course if you want that. And the mobile version has animation options so you can animate your text and photos that the web version still don't have it, and also there is paid and free version of the spark and of course with the paid version you will have some benefits as you can see here on the screen. Right now let me show you how you can create Insta stories using the Adobe spark app on the phone fast and easy. First you need to open Adobe spark post app and this is how it looks it's really nice easy and simple to use and it has more than 20,000 different templates that you can choose from and modify them how everyone. And also you can choose from and modify them however you want. And also you can make your own starting from scratch basically from a blank piece of paper if that's something that you want. You have feature templates, premium animation, collage, seasonal, lifestyle, business, school, travel, food, craft, and also you can search for something custom, that suits your needs by entering keywords in a search bar. So I will type animated text and search for that and we have a plenty of animated text templates so let's go back and I will use this one because I really like it I need to click on it and now I will be able to edit it this is how it looks when it's animated but now I can change everything that I want I can change the font the color the background I can add some photos videos add more add more elements, do a lot of crazy stuff, but we will not go so crazy. For this example, I will show you how you can really easily change something here. So I will click on the text, double tap it. And now I can just delete it and type my own text and press done. And this is how it looks. If I press this small play button, it will animate it and I can can move it make it smaller and bigger rotate it do whatever I want but I will put it a little bit more up and if I go down and scroll to these options I can change I can go to styles and change the style by rotating this wheel and I can just scroll it and use something that i like i don't need to have some kind of design skills i can just use the spark presets that they have it so let's see let's go back to this one and i will go to font and i will change font actually i will use let's see let's use some cool font maybe this yeah i like this so's press play. Make awesome insta stories easily. Great. Then I can go to spacing and I can increase the spacing between the lines or decrease and also between the letters. But this is how I like it. And I don't like this train I will click on the train, press delete, delete it and now I can add something else like text image with the icon sticker logo we will do that later I can change the colors so see this a brand part this is my brand colors that I already put it on the web app so I can have my brand colors here or I can choose between plenty of color palettes already offered here, so let's use this one, for example, and just which click on the shuffle button and choose. Maybe this. This looks cool. I will press done and also I can change the texture back, there move it, change the opacity color, etc, and also I can replace it to any other texture that I want. Instead of that one there are plenty of textures there and icon and whatever you want. Also I can change the opacity of the texture if I want. maybe I don't want so visible so something like this is cool. And then I will add a sticker because this will be an Insta story and I want this to take us to our video I will go and search for Svip Up stickers so let's go with with this one this looks cool and I can move it, make it bigger or smaller zoom it actually let's click on it and go to edit go to scale and make it a bit smaller move it a little bit down and this is how it looks like let's press play and this is how it looks and now we can go again click on the text and go to the effects and add a shadow right here and here we can go and change the opacity and direction of the shadow but I think this is pretty cool I will press done maybe less opacity press Done and this is it now let's press play this is really cool maybe I want to change animation so I can go to animation right here and change something else maybe I want something like this or maybe something like this or maybe make awesomes the stories easily Whatever you want. This is cool. But I like this one I will press done and now guys you can save it and export it and publish it to Instagram But if you want to have this exactly the same thing maybe for Instagram post or maybe for Facebook cover or whatever if you want to have it in different size you don't need to worry about the size anytime here you can just go to resize and maybe you want like Instagram post or maybe you want like Facebook cover no problem let's press play awesome it will be there or maybe you want something like snapchat you have it there too! Or some custom sizes here Of course, you can just type on dimensions and press done And that's it! So you don't need to worry about this things a spark will automatically resize everything for you Now you just need to go and export as a video animation if you want to have it animated or as still image if you want to have it just as a photo and you are done and then you will have it saved in my post section among the other stories that you made so for example i made this story as introduction tonight photography this is how it looks with my branding applied on it with my font my colors my logo and that's it now let me show you really quickly how to apply the branding thing. First, you need to choose the template that you want to edit. I will use this one just for this example and now all you need to do is to go to a brand icon down below, choose the brand that I want to apply in this case I have only my own brand but if you're doing this for your clients, you can set as many brands as you want here, chose one of them, and just apply it. Click on the button and this is it. If you click multiple times it will scroll through a different Colors in the same color palette until you're satisfied with the look that you have and that's it now I applied my own style my own font my own logo in upper right corner with my own Colors and this is awesome read guys so that's it for today I really hope that you like Adobe Spark app as much as. So in case you want to start making some really awesome eye-catching design fast and easily, this is really cool way to do it. You have the link down there in the description. Check it out, sign up, download the app and start enjoying these beautiful possibilities that Adobe Spark provides. Have fun experiment and see you in my next fun episode. Bye-bye.
